relationships.subject: TNF-alpha
relationships.evidence_quote: Peripheral sensitization can be accounted for by the release of proinflammatory mediators (e.g., TNF-alpha, IL1-beta, IL6)

relationships.subject: trigeminal nerve injury
relationships.evidence_quote: Injury to the trigeminal nerve produces alterations in trigeminal primary afferents that can be manifested in a variety of changes

key_findings: Review: trigeminal nerve injury models show peripheral sensitization (proinflammatory mediators, TRPV1, P2X, CGRP, CB2, ion channels) and trigeminal central sensitization.
Genetically different rodent strains vary considerably in nerve injury-induced nociceptive behaviour and trigeminal central sensitization.
